Maya T: morning folks, quick hiccup on day 1. Okta push keeps failing with 'timestamp invalid' when I try to approve on my phone. also running `op signin redwood` afterwards gives a state_mismatch. any quick fixes?

Marie (IT): welcome Maya! 'timestamp invalid' usually means your phone's clock is off. can you check device time & time zone and enable network time sync? i'll hold on the 2FA reset until you try that.

Maya T: ah — phone was set to the wrong timezone after travel. switched to network time and retried the push, got a green check.

Alex P: nice. for the 1Password CLI state_mismatch, try: 1) close existing 1Password sessions in your browser, 2) run `op signin redwood --raw` then `eval $(op signin redwood --raw)` so the CLI doesn't rely on the local callback listener. that usually bypasses the redirect race.

Maya T: ran the --raw flow and it's working now. thanks!

OnboardBot: Checklist update: Maya T completed "MFA enrollment" and "1Password CLI" at 2026-03-27 12:02 UTC.

Marie (IT): all set — welcome to Redwood, Maya! ping here if anything else pops up. :wave:
